mods.name: FarFuits
mods.summary: Um mod leve de agricultura inteligente que cria, planta, irriga, colhe, replanta e armazena as plantações automaticamente usando um único bloco.
mods.summary_en: A lightweight smart farming mod that automatically creates, plants, irrigates, harvests, replants, and stores crops using a single block.
mods.description:
🍎| Farfuits
Smart Farming, Made Simple!

Farfuits adds a compact Farmer Drone Block that automates your farm without complicated machinery.

🍎| Features
Automatic farmland creation and irrigation
Planting, harvesting, and replanting
Adjustable farm sizes from 3×3 to 15×15
Custom GUI with crop selection
Automatic/Mixed farming mode
Wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot, melons, and pumpkins
Automatic storage in a connected chest
Simple ON/OFF control
One Block • One Chest • One Automated Farm

🍎| Requirements
Minecraft 26.3
Fabric Loader
